name: Amakami Yume
source:
The second among the 3 sisters. A nurse, who works in the hospital next to the school.

Although has a very gentle and cheerful personality, when it comes to taking care of patients, is very earnest. Knowledge regarding nursing is also very deep.

However, on the other hand, is a very heavy drinker to the point, that she says that she will die if she cannot drink alcohol every day. She wants to drink while watching her younger brother. She never drinks, if not in front of her brother.

Although becomes pessimistic while drinking, her aggressiveness towards her brother increases. Starts approaching him while taking off her clothes.

One time when her brother got angry, started taking clothes off, while crying.

Even after waking up from her drunk state, remembers "I will take responsibility" and so approaches her brother again.

[Translated from [url=http://www.lune-soft.jp/game/1430#character]website[/url]]
